 Dengue claims 7 more lives, 1,373 hospitalised in 24 hours
 All seven deaths reported in Dhaka South as this year's death toll rises to 364 
 Published : 21 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 21 October 2026, 16:28
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least seven people died of dengue, and 1,373 others were hospitalised across the country in 24 hours till 8:00am this morning.
 All the deaths were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest figures, the death toll from dengue this year has risen to 364, while the total number of cases has reached 116,990.
 Currently, 5,970 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
